ai_summary: Adroit Infotech Limited has announced a non-binding agreement to acquire a majority stake in Verso Altima Group d.o.o., a Croatian IT firm, projecting a significant increase in consolidated revenue to $23-25 million USD. This strategic acquisition aims for European market expansion, enhanced SAP capabilities, and diversified engineering services, with funding planned entirely through internal accruals and equity issues to avoid third-party debt. A key red flag is that the agreement remains non-binding and the exact cost of acquisition is yet to be finalized, introducing uncertainty regarding the deal's completion and full financial implications.
